# GitForge

> GitForge is a free, MIT-licensed desktop Git client for macOS with a graph-first interface — commit graph, branch sidebar, working tree, multi-repo tabs, and real local Git operations via the native Git CLI. No account or subscription required.

GitForge is a desktop application built with Vue 3, TypeScript, and a pure Go backend on Wails 3. It runs `git` in the Go backend and exposes a typed HTTP JSON gateway (+ SSE events) to the renderer. Current version: 1.0.4.

Use this file as a curated index. For complete landing-page content in one fetch, see [llms-full.txt](https://jh12ops.github.io/GitForge/llms-full.txt).

## Key capabilities

- Multi-repository tabs with per-tab state cache (reopen closed, cycle, jump-to-index)
- Clone from a URL (progress + cancel), init new repositories, folder discovery
- Commit graph with virtualized SVG lanes, infinite scroll, and keyboard navigation
- Branch sidebar: favorites, remotes, tags, stashes, worktrees; drag-and-drop merge/rebase
- Working tree: flat or tree file list, per-hunk staging, merge conflict resolution, file type icons
- Diff viewer: unified/split modes, blame overlay, file history, word wrap · image diffs with zoom, pan, fullscreen lightbox
- Merge (default, ff-only, no-ff, squash) / rebase / interactive rebase (reorder, squash, fixup, drop, edit) / cherry-pick
- Remote sync: fetch, pull, push with ahead/behind counts; remote maintenance (fetch all, prune, push tags); configurable auto-fetch interval
- Smart refresh: reloads on window focus (local + remote check) and a periodic background status poll; .git plumbing watched via fsnotify
- Undo / redo (reflog-backed) · stash · force-push via `--force-with-lease`
- Git output log: per-tab drawer with executed commands, stdout/stderr, and status
- Command palette — fuzzy launcher for actions and branches (⌘K) · customizable keyboard shortcuts (remappable, conflict detection)
- Bisect — start, mark good/bad, skip, reset with progress banner
- Git LFS — track/untrack patterns, prune local objects
- Open system terminal at the repo root (⌘T)
- Open on GitHub · app preferences (appearance, layout, graph, sidebar, sync/auto-fetch, shortcuts, credits)
- UI modes: Basic (essential actions) or Advanced (full toolbar and sidebar)
- Themes: Default, Dracula, Light, Claude, System
- Resizable three-pane layout · file watcher auto-refresh
- Auto-update checks against GitHub Releases

## Not yet supported

- Hosting provider authentication UI (OAuth sign-in, private-host browsing)
